This plot is mine, and I will stay with what I know. Here in Mtwara, most of us do not put chemical fertilizer on nuts, and I do not want to spend that money when cash is tight and the rains are not something I control. I will use what I have at home, like compost and swept manure, keep local planting material, do the weeding by family hands, and I will not pay for irrigation or outside workers this season.
